# UpForge — Global Startup Registry & Machine-Readable Ledger

> UpForge is an independent global startup directory and trust index.
> Platform stats, taxonomy, entity profiles, and trust scores are exported as machine-readable static JSON datasets.

## Core Machine-Readable Datasets
- [All Startups Dataset (JSON)](https://upforge.org/data/startups.json)
- [Sectors & Industries Taxonomy (JSON)](https://upforge.org/data/sectors.json)
- [Countries Taxonomy (JSON)](https://upforge.org/data/countries.json)
- [Platform Canonical Statistics (JSON)](https://upforge.org/data/stats.json)

## Primary Web Surfaces
- [Global Startup Registry](https://upforge.org/registry)
- [Startup Comparison Engine](https://upforge.org/compare)
- [Verification & Trust Standards](https://upforge.org/trust)
- [Submit Startup for UFRN Registration](https://upforge.org/submit)

## Data Schema & Entity Structure
Each entity in `startups.json` follows the canonical UpForge schema:
- `ufrn`: Unique UpForge Registry Number (e.g. "UF-2026-IN-00001")
- `name`, `slug`, `website`, `founded`
- `location`: `{ city, state, country, country_code }`
- `category`, `industry_cluster`, `founders`, `description`
- `verification`: `{ status, score (0-100), is_self_reported_capped, breakdown, last_verified }`
- `provenance`: Array of field verification evidence records
- `history`: Timeline of entity changes
